title: Game I've been working on for about 4 months.
author: Aggravating_Day_1302
selftext: Been working on this for about 4 months now.  It's finally starting to get to where I want it. Haven't really had a plan on releasing it.  I really just started as a side project and since I've never attempted a game before. It's been really fun, so far. Lots of things to still learn, it's been a ton of trial and error to this point.

comments.author: adolphite
comments.body: You are very imaginative. Did you develop all the visual assets yourself?

replies.author: Aggravating_Day_1302
replies.body: Yeah, I'd basically describe what I was envisioning to Gemini and after lots and lots of iterations, I mostly got what I wanted.

comments.author: Guildbound
comments.body: Really nice animations what was your asset pipeline using AI ?

replies.author: Aggravating_Day_1302
replies.body: Gemini paints everything on a flat grey or magenta background, and custom Godot scripts cut it out, split sheets into frames and make textures tile. For animation, Kling turns one Gemini painting into a short side-view video, and a script removes the background and fits the frames to the fight timing. Moving parts come from asking Gemini for the same picture with and without the part and cutting out the difference. Claude writes the code and the tools.

comments.author: sfscsdsf
comments.body: if you are releasing on steam, avoid getting your hardworking ai assisted game buried in a pile of other ai slops, don’t put the ai tag for your game, non developers equate ai with bad and not worthy directly without much thinking these days.

replies.author: Aggravating_Day_1302
replies.body: It's really just a passion project and I don't care if I do or don't make any money.  I'm already super happy people think it looks good. If 2-5 people found my game enjoyable, I'd be stoked.  I hope people can tell I'm putting a lot of work into this and it's not just "AI slop."
